paragraphs: inHANCE Utilities Solutions sells utility billing and customer information software to municipal utilities. The company describes the market for that software as small-to-mid sized utility companies. Work on utility billing software for that market is dated on the about page to 1976.

Impresa is a customer information and utility billing system for small-to-mid sized utilities. inHANCE Small Business is a customer information and utility billing system for micro-to-small sized utilities. PowerManager covers billing, accounting and financial management for micro-to-mid sized utilities.

FieldHawk is a web-based tool for utility technicians that creates and manages digital work orders. The WebShare portal gives utility customers self-service tools for service requests, consumption tracking, bill viewing and payments. Cloud Hosting runs those systems on servers held in data centers rather than on physical servers at the utility.

quote.text: 50 YEARS OF UTILITY BILLING SOFTWARE FOR 550+ MUNICIPAL UTILITIES ACROSS NORTH AMERICA
